GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2025-03-31T17:16:26Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: uni-meter does not work when at startup the mqtt input device was not available
Description: uni-meter-1.1.3

Having in file `/etc/uni-meter.conf` the following MQTT input source, where 192.168.1.4:1883 is the Home Assistant MQTT broker:

```
  input-devices {
    mqtt {
      url = "tcp://192.168.1.4:1883"
      username = "mqttclient"
      password = "****"

      power-phase-mode = "mono-phase"
      energy-phase-mode = "mono-phase"

      channels = [{
        type = "json"
        topic = "tele/tasmota_FA33FC/SENSOR"
        channel = "power-total"
        json-path = "$..power"
      },{
        type = "json"
        topic = "tele/tasmota_FA33FC/SENSOR"
        channel = "energy-consumption-total"
        json-path = "$..energy_sum"
      },{
        type = "json"
        topic = "tele/tasmota_FA33FC/SENSOR"
        channel = "energy-production-total"
        json-path = "$..energy_supply"
      }]
    }
  }
```

When uni-meter systemd unit is started before the Home Assistant MQTT broker is up and running, then uni-meter will not start working at all, even not when the MQTT broker becomes available.

It would be better if uni-meter would try every e.g. 1 min again, and start working as soon as the input source becomes available.

Currently, the solution is to restart uni-meter after mqtt broker is running.
